text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrating the fruits of her rigorous 
training, Grass Wonder claimed victory 
over El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To face Maruzensky in a direct showdown, 
she hopes to enter the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if running away from Grass Wonder, El 
Condor Pasa left the scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid a swirl of mixed emotions, the wind 
grew sharper and colder with every passing 
day, heralding the winter of their Classic 
year—
